notes: High-level: MerchStream is a mid-market -> enterprise e-comm marketplace (multi-brand). 12M SKUs, heavy seasonal cadence (Black Fri -> Cyber Mon, end-of-season).
Primary ask: semantic search + reranking that keeps top-N latency under 120ms p95 and cost per query < $0.005 (target, negotiated).
Current infra: Elasticsearch for baseline search (+ in-house heuristics for merchandising). Interested in adding vector-based recall + ML reranker to reorder results at query time.
Data volume: ~12M unique product embeddings, 30M images (image embeddings later), incremental daily SKU churn ~10k adds/updates.
Query profile: baseline 600 qps peak normal; seasonal peak 3-4k qps sustained for 48-72 hours during big promos.
Constraints: no full on-prem. Need VPC peering, KMS integration, and audit logs. Data residency: US first, EU later.
Quote from CTO (12/2025): 'We need predictable cost on seasonality — we can tolerate minor quality dropoffs rather than 5x cost spikes.'

AE notes: Favoring Dedicated for guaranteed throughput + predictable unit economics; will evaluate Hosted with burst policy as cheaper alternative if Redwood Optimize recommendations reduce cost per query.
SE notes: want to test hybrid pipeline: ES for filter/keyword, vector recall for semantic candidates, lightweight reranker (distilBERT) for final sort. Concerned about KV cache size for 12M entries.
Security: require SSO for console, role-based access, per-token audit logging; CISO asked for SOC2 + encryption-at-rest details (drive: security-faq).
POC asks: ingest 250k seed SKUs, measure end-to-end p95, ops cost, and index refresh time. Will run search A/B vs current ES baseline for conversion delta.
Budget: placeholder $120k-$300k ARR depending on burst pricing and SLA level.
